name: Ahmedabad
notes: Zones are the seven AMC administrative zones, one forecast point each (approximate centroids).
Tier thresholds are Ahmedabad's forecast-Tmax alert levels: yellow 41-42.9 C, orange 43-44.9 C, red >= 45 C (Hess et al. 2018; AMC HAP).
The hot-night threshold is illustrative and should be set by the city.
To avoid alert fatigue, departments are tasked only once the plan is active (yellow tier or above); workers get a WBGT push alert from band 2 on any day, and band 1 on request.

actions.text: Open drinking-water points at bus stops, labour nakas and markets in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Ahmedabad HAP: drinking water at public places

actions.text: Ask builders in {zone} to shift heavy work out of {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Ahmedabad HAP: changes to outdoor work schedules

actions.text: Keep cooling spaces (temples, public buildings) open in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Ahmedabad HAP: cooling spaces during orange/red alerts

actions.text: Put UHCs and hospitals serving {zone} on heat alert; stock ORS and ice packs.
actions.ref: Ahmedabad HAP: hospital preparedness on orange/red alerts

actions.text: Send outreach teams and 108 ambulances on standby to hotspots in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Ahmedabad HAP: red alert emergency response

reference_event.text: Replay of the May 2024 Gujarat heatwave (peak days around 20-25 May). Check IMD station values before quoting a number.

rights.en: NDMA heatwave guidelines ask employers to move heavy outdoor work to cooler hours and provide water, shade and rest. Ask your contractor for these.
rights.hi: NDMA दिशानिर्देश: भारी बाहरी काम ठंडे घंटों में करवाया जाए और पानी, छाँव व आराम दिया जाए। अपने ठेकेदार से यह माँगें।
